minOrder.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
minOrder.a: Most products start at 50 units; our team ships smaller pilot runs for new accounts on request.

leadTime.q: How fast can you produce 1,000 units?
leadTime.a: Standard lead time is 10 business days from sample approval; rush programs can ship in 5.

art.q: Can you redraw or vectorise my logo?
art.a: Yes — our in-house art team prepares production-ready files at no extra cost.

shipping.q: Do you handle international shipping and customs?
shipping.a: We support DDP from our US, EU and APAC hubs, with consolidated invoices for finance teams.

cta.heading: Ready to plan your next program?
cta.subtitle: Submit an RFQ — a real human will reply within one business day.

bulk.metaTitle: Bulk orders — tiered pricing on every product
bulk.metaDescription: Tiered bulk pricing on apparel, drinkware, accessories and stickers — with sample approval and global delivery.

hero.title: Bulk pricing that gets better as you scale
hero.subtitle: Tiered unit prices, free samples on qualifying programs, and a dedicated production manager from 500 units.

tiers.heading: Tiered pricing
tiers.subtitle: Indicative starting prices per unit. Final pricing depends on print method and SKU mix.

sampling.title: Free sampling on 500+
sampling.body: We ship a physical sample for sign-off before going to production.

art.title: Art prep included
art.body: Vectorisation, colour matching and production-file prep at no extra cost.

manager.title: Dedicated manager
manager.body: A single point of contact for the entire program.

delivery.title: Global delivery
delivery.body: DDP shipping available from US, EU and APAC fulfilment hubs.

minimum.a: Bulk pricing applies from 50 units; volume discounts unlock from 250.

mix.q: Can I mix sizes and colors within a tier?
mix.a: Yes — size and color mix is included as long as the SKU stays the same.

split.q: Can you split-ship to multiple addresses?
split.a: Absolutely. Provide the address sheet during checkout and we'll handle the rest.
